BiblicalUsage: Bochim means weeping, and it is the place where Israel wept. In Judges 2:1 the angel of the Lord comes up to Bochim and says, I will never break my covenant with you — but you have not obeyed my voice. In Judges 2:5 the people lifted up their voice and wept there, and they called the name of that place Bochim.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bochim is named for the right thing: they wept because they had disobeyed, and the weeping was the beginning of the way back.
